system_a.summary: Guests describe a private, affordable basement apartment near Asheville, with a separate entrance, quiet wooded or mountain surroundings, a porch or deck, and a good-value, no-frills stay. Recent reviews (2024–2026) mostly mention cleanliness, easy check-in, responsive hosts, peacefulness, and convenient access to Asheville attractions. Recurring limitations across years include a steep driveway, a narrow path to the door, and a walk up from parking that one 2024 reviewer said could be hard for older guests. Recent concerns: three reviews (2025–2026) say the guest entrance could not be locked securely, and earlier reviews raised the same lock issue plus missing window coverings. Historical reports (2019 and earlier) also mention a sagging bed, spiders, noise from the hosts upstairs, weak water pressure or a toilet backup, and tense host interactions. Reports may not reflect current conditions.

system_b.summary: Guests across 2014–2026 generally describe this basement suite as a clean, quiet, good-value, no-frills stay about 10–20 minutes from downtown Asheville (car needed), with easy check-in and mostly responsive hosts. Security is the main concern. Reviewers from 2015 through early 2026 said the guest entrance could not be locked securely; three 2025–2026 reports use identical wording, so they may not be independent, and current status is unverified. Early reviewers also cited missing window coverings and unlockable garage doors. Others praised the private entrance and felt safe. Access can be steep, rocky, or narrow, difficult for some guests (latest report 2024). Overhead noise (2017, 2019), sagging beds (2018–2019), cool nights, and 2019 plumbing, supply, and host-friction complaints were minority reports, contrasted by many comfortable-bed and quiet-stay comments. Present conditions are unconfirmed.

selected_claims.claim: Multiple reviewers across 2015-2026 report the guest entrance cannot be locked securely and say this made them uncomfortable. Three near-identical reports in 2025-2026 (R0094, R0096, R0104) suggest the issue may persist, but their identical wording means they may not be independent. One early reviewer said the door was left unlocked by the owners but judged the neighborhood safe.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Reported from 2015 through Feb 2026; most recent reports 2025-2026
selected_claims.uncertainty: Current lock status is not verified. The 2025-2026 reports use identical wording. Only a minority of reviewers raised it, and most reviews do not mention it.

selected_claims.claim: Some reviewers raised privacy and security concerns beyond the door. Early reviewers noted no curtains or blinds, and a 2019 reviewer noted only a sheer on the window. A 2019 reviewer also said the garage and upstairs-guest doors could not be locked and the garage door was left open for long periods, and advised removing valuables.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Unknown whether window coverings or garage practices have changed.

selected_claims.claim: Many reviewers describe the private entrance, privacy and a safe, peaceful neighborhood positively, including a 2020 and a 2024 review that mention feeling safe.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Positive privacy comments mostly concern the separate entrance, not lock security.

selected_claims.claim: Access is physically demanding for some guests. Reviewers describe a steep, rocky or winding driveway and road, a long uphill walk from parking that can be hard for older people (2024), and a narrow roughly 2-foot passage by the stairs to reach the door. Others found parking and access easy.
selected_claims.uncertainty: A minority of reviewers raised it; severity varies by guest mobility. Current conditions are unverified.

selected_claims.claim: Noise from the hosts' living space overhead was reported by two guests. One in 2017 described stomping early in the morning, and one in 2019 could hear footsteps. Most reviewers describe the place as very quiet and peaceful.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Complaints from 2017 and 2019; quiet praise continues through 2025
selected_claims.uncertainty: Overhead noise appears to be a minority, historical issue; not confirmed as current.

selected_claims.claim: Bed comfort is divided. Many reviewers praise comfortable beds. A few (2018, 2019 x2) reported a sagging or uncomfortable bed causing backaches. Some noted the room is cool overnight and the temperature cannot be controlled, though a space heater and blankets are provided.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Sagging bed complaints 2018-2019; no recent reports
selected_claims.uncertainty: The mattress may have been replaced; no evidence either way.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness is praised very consistently, including recent stays in 2024-2026. One 2019 guest saw spiders in the bathroom.

Most reviewers describe hosts as responsive and friendly, and check-in as easy, with instructions or coded entry and recent confirmations in 2025-2026. A minority reported friction: aloof host behavior (2017), a plumbing dispute and a checkout message (2019), and a refused partial refund (2019).
selected_claims.uncertainty: The negative accounts are individual and unverified.

selected_claims.claim: Plumbing and supplies issues appeared in 2019: weak water pressure with a toilet backup, and no soap in the bathroom. Another reviewer noted only two towels for three guests.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No later reports; current condition unknown.

selected_claims.claim: The unit is a basic, no-frills basement suite with essentials (mini fridge, coffee, space heater, porch/deck), generally as described. One 2019 guest said the patio differed from the photos. A $17 per-guest fee surprised one 2017 guest.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Fee communication and patio changes are single reports.

selected_claims.claim: Value is praised heavily, and the location is convenient to Asheville, about 10-20 minutes from downtown, though a car is needed.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Car dependence is mentioned by only a few reviewers.
